summary: Starlink AI Acquisition Corporation filed a Form 8-K reporting the consummation of its IPO of 10,000,000 units at $10.00/unit ($100M gross proceeds) and a simultaneous private placement of 221,500 units to sponsor JKapital Ltd. at $10.00/unit ($2.215M). Each unit comprises one ordinary share and one right to receive one-fourth of a share upon a future business combination. $100.5M was placed in a trust account. This is a standard SPAC formation and IPO closing, not a special-situation event. The filing reports the capital structure and trust mechanics. No business combination target has been announced. What to watch: the SPAC's two-year window to identify and close an acquisition target.
